description: This file defines the Admin_UI_ZoneIdField class, a PHP class for rendering a zone selection dropdown in the Revive Adserver admin interface, including methods for retrieving zones based on user permissions and displaying them as options.

classes.name: Admin_UI_ZoneIdField
classes.description: A PHP class for rendering a zone selection dropdown in the admin interface, with methods to fetch zones based on user permissions and display options.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs HTML select element with zone options.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of zones filtered by user permissions and optional filters.

methods.name: getForecastType
methods.description: Returns a forecast type code based on the current filter.

methods.name: displayZonesAsOptionList
methods.description: Displays the zones as HTML option elements.
